review_requirements: Confirm that the separate protocol and statistical-analysis files sharing the exact title, NCT identifier, and 2015-11-18 date form a valid governing pair.
Verify the 1,152-participant, 90%-power, 0.2%-incidence calculation and recover the omitted alpha and assumptions if possible.
Define the analysis population, incidence estimators and intervals, and operational AKI-reversibility rule.
Replace or clarify the ambiguous ANOVA/t-test language so serial within-participant measurements are handled correctly.
Specify missing-data, multiplicity, and study-success rules before treating the case as confirmatory; retain it as an auxiliary observational safety case meanwhile.
